name: publish-article
description: A free Claude Code plugin for publishing Word drafts to your website and social media

plugins.name: publish-article
plugins.description: Turn a Word (.docx) draft into a published article on a markdown or static-site website without losing text boxes, SmartArt, images or the author's emphasis, then make a branded social pack from it: carousel, quote cards, link image and post copy. Uses your own house style and brand.
